name: cleanroom_enzgfm_protein_feature_v1
purpose: Evaluate an enzyme-specialized foundation representation for protein-cold and bidirectional enzyme-reaction retrieval without using outer benchmark labels for selection.

external_pretraining_boundary.status: external foundation-pretrained representation transfer, not random-init clean
external_pretraining_boundary.restriction: No downstream association or retrieval supervision outside each clean train split may be used. Exact sequence presence in foundation pretraining is not claimed absent.
external_pretraining_boundary.author_embedding_semantics: truncate sequences >1000 aa to first500+last500; EsmTokenizer; final hidden state mean over real tokens

feature_extraction.batched_masked_mean_equivalence: validated on 8 representative real proteins: cosine ~1.0 and max abs difference <=1.91e-6 versus author-style single-item mean pooling
feature_extraction.throughput_validation: length-bucketed batch16: 16.55 seq/s on 32 representative proteins, ~9.5 GiB peak GPU memory; 256-protein end-to-end smoke completed with all finite embeddings

development_protocol.split: existing strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint hash double-cold folds
gate_A_candidates: equal-block-normalized concat of ESM-C and EnzGFM
development_protocol.gate_A_selection: balanced R2E and E2R common-IR metrics across folds; no direction may be silently omitted
development_protocol.gate_B: combine the Gate-A selected protein representation with the already internally selected RDKit+ reaction representation and rerun the same internal folds before any outer protein-cold reveal

outer_gate: Only after Gate A and Gate B are frozen may reactzyme_enzyme_projected_protein_cold or temporal_post2020_protein_cold be evaluated.
